usage: Run with reference/flashmoe on PYTHONPATH (e.g. PYTHONPATH=reference/flashmoe python -c 'import base'). The RESOLVE case adapter that base.py was written against is not published; the E8_mega_kernel_h100 package here is a standalone shim providing the imported names (CASE_ID, Profile/profile, environment_profile, validate_inputs per input-domain.txt, and this repository's own make_inputs, which ignores the category).
